spans.s:
अ॑ध (cf. अथ) then, so, and, but, therefore,
accordingly (esp. after a rel., temp., or condit. clause). अध-अध &
अध-अध वा either-or.

अ॑धा (cf. अथ) then, so, and, but, therefore, accordingly
(esp. after a rel., temp., or condit. clause). अध-अध & अध-अध
वा either-or.
अधन a. having no wealth, poor.

अधन्य a. the same;
 miserable, unhappy.
अधन्यता f. misery, misfortune.*
अधम॑ a. undermost, lowest, worst of (—˚).
अधमचेष्ट a. of meanest conduct.
अधमधी a. of weak understanding.
अधमयोनिज a. born of lowest origin.
अधमर्ण m. debtor.
अधमर्णिक m. debtor.
अधरारणि॑ f. the nether Araṇi (v. अर॑णि).

अधरोष्ठ n. (adj. —˚ f. ई) netherlip, coll. the
lips.

अधरौष्ठ n. (adj. —˚ f. ई) netherlip, coll. the
lips.

अ॑धर्म m. unrighteousness, injustice, demerit (often
personif.).
अधर्मज्ञ a. not knowing the law.
अधर्मदण्डन n. unjust punishment.
अधर्मभीरु a. afraid of injustice.

अधर्मिष्ठ^1 a. unrighteous, unlawful.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20160418. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/289. note: cf mw, pw, etc. cae has DarmizWa.
अधर्म्य a. unrighteous, unlawful.

अधश्चरणावपात m. prostration at the feet of
a person.
अधःशय॑ a. lying low, i.e. on the ground.
अधःशय्य a. lying low, i.e. on the ground.
अधःशय्या f. lying or sleeping on the ground.
अधःशाख a. having the branches below.
अधःशायिन् a. = अधःशय॑.
अधःस्थ a. being below.
अधार्मिक a. unrighteous, unjust.
अधार्य a. not to be borne or kept up.
आधमन n. mortgage.
आधमर्ण्य n. state of being indebted.
आधव॑ m. stirrer or a stirred mass, mixture.

आधवनी॑य m. a vessel for shaking and cleansing the
Soma.
आधातृ m. = अग्न्याहित + giver, imparter, teacher.
